newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Adsteam seen seller of NatCon stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Adsteam seen seller of NatCon stake.

text.p: The Adelaide Steamship Group (Adsteam) group is the likely seller of just under 20 percent of the issued capital of car-parts maker National Consolidated Ltd in the market on Tuesday, National Consolidated said.
"It's my understanding that the Adsteam block has been sold...," NatCon managing director Doug Curlewis told Reuters.
Dealers said the stock was dealt by brokers McIntosh Securities and BT Stockbroking.
"It appears to be stock owned by the Adsteam Group," one Melbourne dealer said.
National Consolidated's major shareholder is Malaysian company Malaysia Mining Corp Bhcd.
At 3.40 p.m. (0540 GMT), National Consolidated shares were 11 cents weaker at 98 cents.
Curlewis said he believed the Adsteam stake had been most likely sold to a range of institutional investors and that he did not suspect a takeover was in the offing.
"My view is that it's not a buyer. It's probably a range of institutional buyers," he said.
Asked if Adsteam had indicated its desire to sell out of the company, he noted the financial troubles Adsteam had experienced over the past five years.

"Given that background and given the continuing issues facing Adsteam, it's not surprising to me that they have decided to realise on the balance of their (roughly) 19 percent of the equity," Curlewis said.
